confirmed: The +40.5526 s ABORT followed the live LiDAR input timeout stop, not a reported tracking fault. Source log says input age 0.756 s exceeded the 0.750 s threshold.

Only one /move_base_simple/goal was recorded. After fresh input returned at source +94.1114 s, the planner explicitly logged validation of fresh perception, feedback and the accepted goal at source +94.7953 s.

Two new ADD trajectory messages arrived at +94.7993/+94.8006 s before safety_speed_limit=-1 at +94.8047 s. A nonzero command arrived at +94.9087 s. This is observed retention and recovery of the accepted navigation task in this perception-timeout episode.
All 554 recorded /tracking_fault messages are false. All recorded Piper execution states are enabled/active, not latched, with feedback valid.
No [FSM][MPPIRefresh] event appears in the supplied 8081 rosout records; the new trajectories at +94.80 s belong to perception-stop recovery, not evidence of MPPIRefresh.

stop_interval.coverage_caveat: /cmd_vel has a 30.397 s receive-time gap from +39.6026 to +69.9997 s; absence of nonzero commands cannot be asserted continuously from command recording alone. /odom continues through that interval.

not_confirmed: The root cause of the live-input interruption is not established by this audit; the timeout message does not by itself identify hardware, software, scheduling or recording causes.

MPPIRefresh request production, eligibility, triggering and success are not validated. /planning/mppi_refresh_request is absent from the supplied extracted topic set. Map-export refresh=1 logs are a different mechanism.
Goal completion is not established: this is a partial capture through +139.634 s with no finish message. Last odometry is not evidence of final goal attainment.
This episode validates observed perception-timeout task retention and resumption only; other transient obstacle/repeated failure recovery branches are not exercised by these observations.

Trajectory coefficients and final endpoint are absent from navigation_evidence.jsonl, so equality of the recovered trajectory endpoint to the original goal is not independently checked here; accepted-goal retention is supported by the explicit FSM log and lack of a replacement goal.
known_remaining_issue: Freshness rejections continue after safety release. From +94.8047 s to capture end, MPPI status has 249 command_delivered, 131 collision_snapshot_unavailable, 44 collision_snapshot_expired_during_plan, 23 inputs_expired_before_delivery and 1 delivery_deadline_exceeded.
